payload.question: 9月份华东地区的回购率是多少

metrics.label: 复购率
metrics.description: 统计周期内下单 2 次及以上的用户数 ÷ 统计周期内下单用户数。按维度拆分时在每个分组内分别计算。

queries.title: 复购率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.month AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN regions AS r
    ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    AND r.region_name = '华东'
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id,
    SUBSTRING(o.order_date, 1, 7)
) AS t
GROUP BY
  t.month
ORDER BY
  month
LIMIT 1000
